content: We need number of aromatic carbons in the sample's molecule. We have no direct description of molecule. We need to get NMR spectra to infer aromatic carbons count. Use carbon_nmr_spectra to get 13C NMR, then count aromatic carbon signals (typically 6-8 ppm region ~120-140 ppm). Could also use retrieve_carbon_shifts to know ranges. Let's get carbon NMR.
